sourceBinding: Implementation base plus exact changed-source digests; the enclosing commit contains the mapped component bytes.
claims: The consumer maps actual prepared/current/explain/history/as-of/search/evidence responses against host-owned World, execution-mode, exact requested-site/subject, authority-expiry and request/correlation bindings. Optional authority echoes cannot contradict the request. Multi-site subjects remain separately bound. A reference is never treated as permission to expand evidence.

Qualified read items retain knowledge state, basis, evidence and contradiction references, missing versus false/null values, event/receipt time, freshness/age, limitations, source identity and per-projection revision. Numeric source revisions normalize to opaque strings. Current items cannot silently omit their value, evidence or basis. Unknown, stale, conflicted, unavailable and notDetected states are not flattened into a boolean or current truth.

Historical observations and registered-entity search matches occupy separate collections from current items. Historical observations are explicitly not qualified as current facts. As-of selection preserves the requested time and selected state independently of the accompanying history page and opaque continuation. A conflicted boundary cannot contain an arbitrarily selected fact.

Evidence mapping preserves exact observation identity, site, value and qualification, classification, transformations, provenance and observation environment separately from the current request environment. Integrity is explicitly producerReported, not independently verified; its digest is labeled as the evidence content revision. Unknown evidence stays unknown. Canonical producer records are not persisted or imported into a shared store.

Mapping snapshots the received JSON and bounds input/output to at most 262144 UTF-8 bytes, with caller item/byte bounds, finite typed numeric fields, explicit timestamp zones/calendar validation, authority expiry and bounded arrays. Malformed mapped fields fail explicitly. Unselected media/watch references on mapped items or the root response are rejected rather than becoming a selected feature. Legacy typed projections now deep-copy nested values.

A public consumer command starts the producer-owned CLI as a separate disposable process, supplies only a generated synthetic token and seeded scenario, and checks all read modes through HTTP. Thirteen semantic checks pass, including original boolean contradictions, withheld old values, known/unknown multi-site subjects, historical pagination and scoped evidence denial. The producer stores only in-memory synthetic data and shuts down after the run or at its finite lifetime.

Eleven cases passed and one multi-site case failed because a single subject binding could not represent multiple site-qualified subjects. Explicit per-site subject bindings corrected the mapping.

limitations: This is a read-mapping component verification, not complete LS-S028 or PV1-T5 acceptance. The server still does not instantiate the PWCE provider. Scope-bound SSE identity/mode propagation, ordered invalidation/cache resynchronization, async authority/capability ports, runtime composition and joint scenarios remain required.

Full mapping-profile schema/fixture digest qualification must be refreshed after the remaining profile components are implemented. Existing foundational prepared-context and fixture pins, published Gateway bundle artifacts and original slice receipts remain unchanged; they are not relabeled as complete mapped-profile acceptance.

The mapper expects its authority, request identity, scope, clock and budget binding from the trusted caller; it does not itself authenticate a network response. The process checks use the existing authenticated client; model-reachable input cannot be promoted to that host binding by this component.

No optional presence, media, renderer or shared-space profile is selected. States unavailable and notDetected have deterministic mapping coverage, not a new real-provider scenario claim. Final prompt/token budgeting and fresh-cache use remain Lifestream runtime responsibilities.
